types.name: RouteSlug
types.description: All 14 valid route slugs (leading-slash paths) used for navigation and route registration across the app.

types.name: StepId
types.description: Unique identifier for each step in the exemplar.tools pipeline, used as keys in content data and pipeline diagram nodes.

types.name: StepLabel
types.description: Human-readable display labels for each pipeline step, shown in sidebar navigation, diagram boxes, and page titles.

types.name: CalloutVariant
types.description: Visual variant for CalloutBox components indicating the type of supplementary information.

types.name: RouteEntry

fields.name: stepId
fields.description: Unique pipeline step identifier.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL path slug for this route (always starts with '/').

fields.name: label
fields.description: Human-readable label displayed in navigation and page headers.

types.description: A single entry in the route map linking a step to its slug and display label, consumed by sidebar nav and route registration.

types.name: RouteEntryList
types.description: Ordered list of all 14 RouteEntry items, defining sidebar order and route registration sequence.

types.name: CalloutItem

fields.name: variant
fields.description: The visual/semantic type of this callout.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The verbatim callout text from howto.md.

types.description: A single callout (gotcha, warning, or tip) to be rendered via the shared CalloutBox component.

types.name: CalloutItemList
types.description: Ordered list of CalloutItem entries for a single step page.

types.name: CommandEntry

fields.name: command
fields.description: The exact CLI command string, verbatim from howto.md.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional prose describing what this command does.

types.description: A single CLI command block with optional description, rendered via the shared CodeBlock component.

types.name: CommandEntryList
types.description: Ordered list of CommandEntry items for a single step page.

types.name: StepContent

fields.name: stepId
fields.description: Unique identifier for this step.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Display label shown as the page title.

fields.name: overview
fields.description: Introductory prose for the step, verbatim from howto.md.

fields.name: commands
fields.description: All CLI commands for this step, in order.

fields.name: callouts
fields.description: Gotchas, warnings, and tips for this step.

fields.name: examples
fields.description: Verbatim example blocks from howto.md.

fields.name: youtubeUrl
fields.description: YouTube video URL for this step, if one exists in howto.md.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version string displayed via VersionBadge, if applicable.

types.description: Complete content payload for one step page, consumed by StepPage to render all sections using shared UI components.

types.name: StepContentMap

fields.name: entries
fields.description: All step content entries; runtime lookup is by stepId.

types.description: Map-like record keyed by StepId holding all StepContent objects; the single source of truth for page data consumed by step page wrappers.

types.name: StepContentList
types.description: Ordered list of StepContent records.

types.name: PipelineNode

fields.name: stepId
fields.description: Step identifier used to look up the route slug for navigation.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text rendered inside the SVG box.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Route slug for click-through navigation.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Horizontal position of the node in the SVG coordinate system.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Vertical position of the node in the SVG coordinate system.

types.description: A single node in the pipeline diagram representing one step, linking to its route for click navigation.

types.name: PipelineNodeList
types.description: All nodes to render in the pipeline diagram SVG.

types.name: string
types.description: TypeScript string primitive.

types.name: number
types.description: TypeScript number primitive.

types.name: boolean
types.description: TypeScript boolean primitive.

types.name: OptionalString
types.description: A string value that may be undefined or empty.

types.name: StringList
types.description: An ordered array of strings, used for example blocks and similar text lists.

types.name: CodeBlockProps

fields.name: code
fields.description: The preformatted CLI command text to display.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional caption/description shown above or below the code.

types.description: Props for the CodeBlock shared component, used by page_content when rendering CLI commands.

types.name: VersionBadgeProps

fields.name: componentName
fields.description: The name of the tool/component to display on the badge.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The version string to display (e.g. 'v1.2.3').

types.description: Props for the VersionBadge shared component, used by page_content to display version info.

types.name: YouTubeEmbedProps

fields.name: url
fields.description: Full YouTube video URL to embed in a responsive iframe.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Accessible title for the iframe element.

types.description: Props for the YouTubeEmbed shared component, used by page_content to embed tutorial videos.

types.name: CalloutBoxProps

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Visual style variant: gotcha, warning, or tip.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The callout body text to display.

types.description: Props for the CalloutBox shared component, used by page_content to render gotchas, warnings, and tips.
